display_long_description:
Scary Baboon Modz is an immersive VR multiplayer horror game set inside a mysterious abandoned underground facility. Once a place of research and experimentation, it has now become home to terrifying creatures that roam the dark corridors. Every hallway hides danger, and every sound could attract something lurking nearby.

Explore laboratories, maintenance tunnels, storage areas, and hidden rooms as you search for a way to survive. Work together with friends or face the nightmare alone. Stay alert, manage your surroundings, and use stealth when needed. Sometimes running is your only option, while other times hiding is the only way to stay alive.

Each session offers unpredictable encounters, tense chase sequences, and new challenges as you uncover the secrets buried deep within the facility. Keep exploring to find hidden areas and discover what happened before everything was abandoned.

Features:
• Immersive VR horror gameplay.
• Online multiplayer with friends.
• Large abandoned facility to explore.
• Unique monsters with different behaviors.
• Intense chase and stealth mechanics.
• Hidden rooms and environmental secrets.
• Atmospheric lighting and sound design.
• Regular updates with new content and improvements.

Can you survive the horrors hidden within the facility and escape before it's too late?
